scenes.title: Pill Week
lines: Filling a parent's weekly pill box, with the plan on the box itself.
For the family member who fills it every Sunday.
A Spectacles lens. Lens Studio 5.24.1, SIK 3.1.0, UI Kit, LEAF 3.0.0.
Screen recording of the Lens Studio preview.
Not run on Spectacles glasses yet.
scenes.say: Every Sunday my family fills a pill box for an older parent. And the mistakes are quiet. A skipped day, a tablet in the wrong slot. So Pill Week puts the plan right on the box.

scenes.title: Two things before the demo
lines: The regimen is a made-up sample of four medicines.
It is not a prescription and not medical advice.
The lens does not read prescriptions or recognize tablets.
Everything here is the Lens Studio preview, in real time.
Nothing in this video has run on Spectacles glasses.
scenes.say: Two quick things. The pill list is made up, just a sample, so it's not advice from a doctor. And the lens doesn't read prescriptions or tablets. This is the Lens Studio preview, recorded live, not Spectacles yet.

scenes.title: The box is here
scenes.rec_note: Stand-in: a 32 x 10 cm weekly box, 4 cm compartments, 45 cm in front of me.
scenes.say: This virtual box stands in for a real one. Seven days, morning and evening, little four centimeter slots, sitting on the table in front of me. When it starts, there's just one button. The box is here.

scenes.title: One medicine at a time
scenes.rec_note: Losartan 50 mg, every morning. Only its 7 compartments light up.
scenes.say: I pinch it, and the first medicine card shows up behind the box. Losartan, fifty milligrams, every morning. Zero of seven so far. And only the seven morning slots light up, in its own blue.

scenes.title: Pinch the compartment you filled
scenes.rec_note: Monday morning: checked, counter 1 of 7. Pinch again: undone.
scenes.say: Every time I drop a tablet in, I pinch that slot. It gets a check and a little dot, and the count goes up. Pinch it again and it's undone.

scenes.title: Wrong compartment
scenes.rec_note: Tuesday evening is refused for Losartan. A low tone plays.
scenes.say: Now say I go for the wrong slot, like Tuesday evening. It won't take it. It flashes, plays a low tone, and the card tells me, not here, Losartan only goes in the mornings.

scenes.title: Skipped turns amber
scenes.rec_note: Wednesday filled while Tuesday is empty: Tuesday turns amber.
scenes.say: If I fill Wednesday and Tuesday is still empty, Tuesday turns amber and says skipped. I see it before I move on. Fill Tuesday, and it clears.

scenes.title: Next medicine
scenes.rec_note: Metformin: all 14. Calcium: Mon, Wed, Fri, Sun evening. B12: Sunday morning.
scenes.say: Next takes me down the list. Metformin lights up all fourteen slots. Calcium is only Monday, Wednesday, Friday and Sunday evening. Vitamin B twelve, just Sunday morning. The dots stack up, so the box shows you what's already inside.

scenes.title: Finish and the summary
scenes.rec_note: A full week, then again with Thursday evening left empty on purpose.
scenes.say: After the fourth medicine, Next turns into Finish. A full week reads fifteen of fifteen in the morning, eleven of eleven in the evening. Then I leave Thursday evening empty on purpose. It's flagged right away, the summary calls it out, and that slot stays amber.

scenes.title: Within reach of a seated user
scenes.rec_leaf: LEAF dc7, IK arm, no fallback
scenes.rec_note: My own eye view. Every button and all 14 compartments reached by direct touch.
scenes.say: A LEAF test moves a simulated arm to every button and all fourteen slots. All seventeen are within reach. But the slots are tight, and sometimes the hand hits the one next door.

scenes.title: Tested with LEAF in the preview
scenes.say: There are seven LEAF tests, one for each thing the lens has to do, and they drive it with real Spectacles input. All seven pass. I also broke one on purpose, just to see it fail.

scenes.title: Not proven yet
lines: Pinch precision on real 4 cm compartments: in the preview the
simulated hand sometimes lands on the next compartment.
Holding the overlay on a real box to about 1 cm.
Light tints over a real lid in kitchen light.
scenes.say: Not proven yet. A real pinch on a four centimeter slot, keeping the overlay on a real box, and the colors on a real lid. Thanks for watching.
